advisories.headline: Tropical Storm Rafael forms in the Caribbean
advisories.watches_warnings: HURRICANE WARNING IN EFFECT FROM BAFFIN BAY TO HIGH ISLAND
discussion_key_points: A well-defined tropical wave associated with a broad low-pressure area over the central Caribbean has organized into Tropical Storm Rafael.
Environmental conditions are favorable with warm sea-surface temperatures and low vertical wind shear.

advisories.headline: Rafael strengthens, expected to enter Gulf of Mexico
advisories.watches_warnings: HURRICANE WARNING IN EFFECT FROM BAFFIN BAY TO HIGH ISLAND
discussion_key_points: Rafael is tracking west-northwest and is expected to pass over or near the Yucatan Peninsula within 24-48 hours.
Land interaction may cause temporary weakening before the storm enters the Bay of Campeche/Gulf of Mexico.

Rapid intensification (RI) is occurring. Rafael has intensified more than 35 knots in 24 hours.
Rafael is forecast to continue strengthening to Category 3 intensity before landfall.

Preparation time is running out — residents in Zones A and B should evacuate immediately.
